entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you with your VeloFit products today?
Hi David... um, I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I think I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It's just... I changed my mind. It was a total impulse buy before the holidays, and honestly, I just don't use it. I feel terrible about it, and I really could use the money back.
I understand completely. Sometimes a product just doesn't fit into the routine the way we expect. I'll just need to pull up your account to check the return eligibility. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I've been a VeloFit customer for years... I just hope there's something you can do.

I appreciate your loyalty, and I'll do my best. I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered about 18 days ago. Typically, for a simple change of mind, our primary solution would be to suggest our official VeloFit resale marketplace.
Oh... I see. So I can't return it? I was really counting on that refund.
Well, let me not get ahead of myself. Let me just confirm the specific policy for the Cadence Sensor. Please hold.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I've just checked the knowledge base, and I have good news! The VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our standard 90-day return policy.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! So I can send it back?

Absolutely. Since you received it only 18 days ago, you are well within the timeframe. I can start the return process right now and email you a pre-paid shipping label. You'll receive a full refund once we receive the item back at our warehouse.
David, thank you so much! You have no idea what a help that is. I was so worried. Thank you!
You are very welcome! I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. The email with the shipping label is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything! You've been wonderful. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
